newsitem.title: FRANCE: SGS-Thomson says to outperform market - FT.
newsitem.headline: SGS-Thomson says to outperform market - FT.

text.p: European semi-conductor maker SGS-Thomson will continue to outperform the market, chief executive Pasquale Pistorio told Britain's Financial Times.
"The way we are structured, we should continue to outperform the market," the newspaper quoted him as saying.

Pistorio said he expected little change in the balance of the firm's product portfolio, with about 60 percent of income coming from differentiated products and 40 percent from standard products, the newspaper said.

Pistorio was "a little bit disappoined" by the firm's share price fall since Wednesday, when it published a 19 percent rise in 1996 results to $625.5 million but also warned on first quarter results in 1997 after a weak finish to 1996, it added.
